name: 24 Hours in Elevator...
desc:
Elevator that stops in time? What's going on here? Try to survive 24 hours in an elevator and solve all its mysteries, but don't forget that the time eater is always hunting for you!

🍽 Keep an eye on the water and food levels.
🏃‍♂️ Collect resources on different floors.
🛠 Overcome the challenges in the elevator.
💰 Get coins for survival and buy items.
🍎 Make a reserve of resources for the future.
⏳ Try not to get caught by the time eater.
👑 Survive for 24 hours and find out what lies beyond time.
